// Background jobs run at once, with their sleeps fast-forwarded: they
// stay Running for as long as they would take.
$ sleep 30 & echo "started $!"
[1] 8180
started 8180
$ jobs
[1]+  Running                    sleep 30
$ ps | grep -c 'sleep 30'
2
$ wait; echo waited $?; jobs
waited 0
$ (echo from bg; sleep 1) & sleep 2
[1] 8189
from bg
$ echo next
next
$ sleep 100 & kill %1; jobs; kill %1
[2] 8194
[1]   Terminated                 (...)
[2]+  Running                    sleep 100
sh: %1: no such job
[exit 1]
$ kill -9 126; ps | grep -c ipcam; kill 999
1
sh: can't kill pid 999: No such process
[exit 1]
$ x=1; f() { x=2; }; f & wait; echo $x
[1] 8209
1

// trap, set -e, set -x, getopts, [[.
$ sh -c 'trap "echo bye" EXIT; echo hi'
hi
bye
$ trap 'echo t' INT; trap; trap - INT; trap
trap -- 'echo t' INT
$ sh -c 'set -e; false; echo not reached'; echo $?
1
$ sh -c 'set -e; false || true; if false; then :; fi; echo survived'
survived
$ set -x; echo traced; set +x; echo $-
+ echo traced
traced
+ set +x
smi
$ set -- -a -b val file; while getopts ab: o; do echo "$o ${OPTARG:-}"; done; shift $((OPTIND-1)); echo "rest: $*"
a 
b val
rest: file
$ [[ abc == a* ]] && echo match; [[ -n x && 1 -lt 2 ]] && echo and; [ a -eq 1 ]
match
sh: missing ]]
sh: a: bad number
[exit 2]
$ [ -c /dev/null -a ! -f /dev/null ] && echo chardev; [ \( 1 = 1 \) -o x = y ] && echo paren
chardev
paren

// Signals to the shell honour trap.
$ trap 'echo got USR1' USR1; kill -USR1 $$; echo after
got USR1
after
$ trap '' HUP; kill -HUP $$; echo still here
still here
$ kill -TERM $$; echo interactive ash ignores TERM
interactive ash ignores TERM
